description.en: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.

description.en: A one-of-a-kind resume builder that keeps your privacy in mind. Completely secure, customizable, portable, open-source and free forever. Try it out today!

description.en: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 记忆与上下文插件：pre-step 自动召回与画像注入、会话捕获、`viking://` URI 防护，以及对接 OpenViking 服务端的 recall/write 记忆工具。

description.en: :rocket: The Ultimate Image Uploader for Efficient Creators. Supports Obsidian, Typora, VS Code etc. and 60+ image hosting services  (S3, GitHub, Cloudflare R2, Imgur, Aliyun OSS...). Paste, upload, done.
description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件生态打造的现代化桌面端解决方案。万物皆「插件」，桌面本身也是「插件」。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件生态提供现代化桌面端解决方案，助力插件的开发与管理。

description.en: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
description.zh: 把 WeKnora 知识库接入 dsh 的四个只读工具：列出知识库、混合检索原文片段、按顺序还原单篇文档，以及直接取用 WeKnora 自己带引用的 RAG 或 ReAct agent 回答（含可续聊的 session id）。

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight 可学习的 Agent 记忆：自动召回与沉淀的长期项目记忆、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆库。

description.en: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
description.zh: 为AI代理提供持久化、自进化的记忆系统，支持混合检索与跨任务技能复用，显著节省令牌开销。

description.en: Integrates a design studio into the AI workspace, enabling editable design creation and collaborative workflows.
description.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成设计工作室，支持可编辑设计与协作流程。

description.en: Adds presentation creation capabilities to the AI workspace, allowing users to design and edit slides.
description.zh: 为 AI 工作区添加演示文稿制作功能，用户可设计与编辑幻灯片。

description.en: Integrates video editing tools into the AI workspace, supporting creation and modification of video content.
description.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成视频编辑工具，支持创建与修改视频内容。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash 提供者换成 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令作用于挂载的资源（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres）而非宿主磁盘，支持按挂载点设置读/写/执行模式、按命令选择沙箱（进程内 monty、pyodide、quickjs；远程 docker、e2b、daytona），并可在虚拟终端中安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws，或自行注册的程序树）作为命令头词。

description.en: A memory management kit that helps agents remember, refine, and recall user information across sessions for personalized interactions.
description.zh: 为智能体提供跨会话记忆管理，帮助记住、优化并回忆用户信息，实现个性化交互。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.
description.zh: BrowserSkill 的 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器自动化桥接插件，通过原生浏览器工具控制可见的 Chrome 和 Edge Agent Window，支持可访问性与 VOM 页面观察、截图、隔离的多会话控制和 Web UI 实时观察浮层。

description.en: A persistent, unified memory layer for all your AI agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, DSH), backed by Markdown and Milvus.
description.zh: 供 DSH 与其他编程 Agent 共享的 Markdown 记忆，支持自动捕获、步骤前上下文注入、搜索召回，以及通过审阅面板实现 memory-to-skill 自进化。

description.en: Provides the main desktop UI shell for the DeepSeek Harness Tauri app, including window layout and basic controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供主界面框架，包括窗口布局和基本控件。

description.en: Implements the central panel interface for the Tauri desktop app, hosting the chat view and interactive components.
description.zh: 实现桌面版的核心面板界面，承载对话视图和交互组件。

description.en: Adds extendable UI components to the Tauri panel, allowing dynamic content and custom views within the interface.
description.zh: 为桌面面板提供可扩展的界面组件，支持动态内容和自定义视图。

description.en: Provides a placeholder UI element for the Tauri panel, used for layout spacing and structural purposes.
description.zh: 为桌面面板提供占位界面元素，用于布局间距和结构用途。

description.en: Enables right-click context menu actions within the Tauri desktop app for quick access to common commands.
description.zh: 在桌面版中启用右键菜单操作，方便快速访问常用命令。

description.en: Manages chat sessions and message history within the Tauri desktop app, supporting multiple concurrent conversations.
description.zh: 管理桌面版中的聊天会话和消息历史，支持多个并发对话。

description.en: Provides the core UI components and styling for the Tauri desktop app, including buttons, inputs, and visual elements.
description.zh: 为桌面版提供核心 UI 组件和样式，包括按钮、输入框和视觉元素。

description.en: Manages workspace and worktree state in the Tauri desktop app, handling file and project context for sessions.
description.zh: 管理桌面版中的工作区和工作树状态，处理会话的文件和项目上下文。

description.en: Whale Girl skin series for DeepSeek Harness. 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的，鲸鱼娘系列皮肤。
description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

description.en: Offers unlimited long-term memory for AI assistants, enabling context retention across sessions and tasks.
description.zh: 为AI助手提供无限长期记忆，跨会话和任务保持上下文连贯。

description.en: Local first, desktop companion platform with animated pets, plugin SDK and coding-agent integrations.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

description.en: Provides a self-hosted, human-in-the-loop task manager for agents, enabling real-time control from mobile, web, or desktop.
description.zh: 提供自托管的真人介入任务管理器，支持从移动端、网页或桌面实时控制智能体。

description.en: Backend for AI coding agents on CloudBase — database, auth, functions via Plugin, Skills & MCP.

description.en: TongFlow film-crew studio for image, voice, music and video production: the agent writes per-asset TongFlow workflow files (.tongflow.json) that run through TongFlow plugins, with an embedded workflow canvas, a shot/character/take project layout and a manga-drama template; sessions starting with @tongflow open the Studio view.
description.zh: 基于 TongFlow 的“片场”插件，用于图片、配音、音乐与视频制作：agent 为每个资产生成 TongFlow 工作流文件（.tongflow.json）并通过 TongFlow 插件执行，内嵌工作流画布，按镜头/角色/take 组织项目，附漫剧模板；以 @tongflow 开头的会话进入 Studio 界面。

description.en: AI 小说创作软件：把灵感、角色、世界观、大纲、章节写作、审稿和修稿组织成可控流程；提供 Windows/macOS 桌面版，支持本地和在线模型。AI Novel Writing Software: Organizes inspirations, characters, worldbuilding, outlines, chapter drafting, review, and revision into a controllable workflow. Features desktop apps for Windows/macOS, Ollama integration, and a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin preview.
description.zh: 安装专用 AI 小说创作预设与工作台：提供带修订号的本地项目资产、紧凑侧边工作台，以及需要原生审批的逐文件变更。

description.en: The most comprehensive DeepSeek Harness plugin market — refreshed daily, sourced across the Internet, reviewed before publishing.
description.zh: 提供可视化插件市场，支持浏览、搜索和安装，每日更新精选内容。

description.zh: 提供用于构建和打包 DeepSeek Harness 桌面伴侣应用的开发套件。

description.zh: 提供用于创建轻量级 DeepSeek Harness 桌面伴侣构建的最小开发工具包。

description.zh: 提供桌面伴侣完整用户界面的网页应用包。

description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏扩展，让 DSH 直接操控你的浏览器，无需视觉能力。

description.en: Connects different parts of the system, possibly automating workflows.

description.zh: 桥接桌面应用与其产品功能，实现不同包之间的特性集成与协同。

description.en: Offers tools for creating and manipulating canvas-based visual content in the desktop workspace.
description.zh: 提供在桌面工作区创建和操作画布视觉内容的工具。

description.en: Provides tools for handling Office documents such as creating and editing files in the desktop app.
description.zh: 提供处理 Office 文档的工具，支持创建和编辑文件。

description.en: Offers project management tools for organizing files, tasks, and resources in the desktop workspace.
description.zh: 提供项目管理工具，用于组织桌面工作区的文件、任务和资源。

description.en: Provides structured UI components for building consistent and organized interface elements.
description.zh: 提供结构化 UI 组件，用于构建一致且有序的界面元素。

description.zh: 促进应用不同进程间的工作产品托管 IPC 通信。

description.zh: 为桌面客户端提供AionUI面板，增强界面交互功能。

description.zh: 在客户端界面中展示实时统计和活动指标，便于监控。

description.zh: 为桌面客户端应用视觉皮肤和主题，改变其外观。

description.zh: 把 Claude Code/Codex/Grok/Kimi 编成团队，Telegram/飞书指挥

description.en: Bundles an agentic AI sandbox matrix for orchestrated multi-environment workflows.
description.zh: 提供沙箱矩阵，用于编排多环境的自动化工作流。

description.en: Postiz Agents CLI - connect it to Claude / OpenClaw / etc, to schedule social media posts 🤖
description.zh: 把 Postiz 接到 Claude、OpenClaw 等 AI 助手，让它们帮你定时发布社交媒体内容。

description.en: Your thinking deserves a map: an infinite canvas where LLM conversations grow into an editable thought graph. Wires are the context.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中嵌入可编辑对话画布，通过连线选择画布请求的上下文，支持分支、合并与本地 Agent 会话导入。

description.en: Provides undo functionality for savepoints in the DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness界面提供保存点的撤销功能。

description.en: A marketplace plugin for discovering and installing DeepSeek Harness extensions.
description.zh: 用于发现和安装DeepSeek Harness扩展的插件市场。

description.zh: 科研工作台，支持 LaTeX 编译、arXiv 管理、实验追踪、指标图表和 SSH 任务编排。

description.en: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel reimbursement summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 IMAP 发票下载、OCR 识别、归档与 Excel 报销汇总。

description.en: 基于 Jingyun Studio + DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 打造的一站式 AI 商业化桌面客户端，一个将 AI 智能体 / 技能 / 工作流转化为可交易商品的完整商业化平台客户端。  井云为 DSH 注入了完整的商业闭环：登录注册 → 会员体系 → 订阅支付 → 云端资产 → 多端同步，让 AI 开发者 30 分钟内将自己的智能体封装为独立的商业产品。

description.zh: 支持小说创作与短剧制作，提供专属技能和模板。

description.zh: 提供命令行工具、模式定义和解析器，辅助开发与分发 DSH 插件。

description.en: Reviews code changes by analyzing diffs and providing feedback.
description.zh: 分析代码差异并审查变更，提供改进建议。

description.en: Creates and edits slide presentations with AI assistance.
description.zh: 利用 AI 辅助创建和编辑幻灯片演示文稿。

description.en: Shared memory for AI agents

description.en: WebView2-based DSH launcher
description.zh: 基于 WebView2 的 DSH 启动器

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Windows 轻量启动器：双击即用，克制的原生体验 / Lightweight Windows launcher for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — double-click to run, native & restrained
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: control how long the dsh service (node) stays alive when using the dsh-launcher shell. Writes %LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-launcher\settings.json (serviceLifetime: 0 always-on, 1 tray-resident, 2 follow-window); the shell applies it on window close / tray exit. No runtime dependencies.

description.en: Serves as the core library for the trading terminal, providing shared data models and utilities for market access.
description.zh: 作为交易终端核心库，为多市场接入提供共享数据模型和工具函数。

description.en: Enables trading connectivity for US markets, integrated with the agent-native trading terminal.
description.zh: 为交易终端提供美国市场（US）的连接能力，支持美股等品种交易。

description.en: Enables trading connectivity for Chinese markets (CN), integrated with the agent-native trading terminal.
description.zh: 为交易终端提供中国市场（CN）的连接能力，支持A股等品种交易。

description.en: Enables trading connectivity for cryptocurrency markets, integrated with the agent-native trading terminal.
description.zh: 为交易终端提供加密货币市场的连接能力，支持币种行情与交易。

description.en: Enables trading connectivity for Hong Kong markets (HK), integrated with the agent-native trading terminal.
description.zh: 为交易终端提供香港市场（HK）的连接能力，支持港股等品种交易。

description.zh: 提供交易终端统一入口，以三栏界面整合多市场行情和可切换连接器。

description.zh: lowtide（退潮）插件能够实现闲时自动批量跑任务——任务框架高度自定义，四种执行策略，L1–L3 半自动/全自动裁决，支持任务编辑与预检，Cordis 微内核集成，桌面网页端通用。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin for phone and tablet access with QR pairing, per-device authorization, revocation, and a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel.
description.zh: 通过二维码配对从移动设备远程访问DSH，支持安全登录和设备授权。

description.en: Provides an adapter for integrating DSH with standard tooling.
description.zh: 提供适配器，用于集成DSH与标准工具。

description.en: Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器中注册方舟 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 与后付费模型路由。

description.en: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.
description.zh: 新增 Managed Agents 设置页，并通过 MCP 工具向方舟云端 Managed Agents 派发长任务、取回轨迹与产物。

description.en: Multi-agent department framework for long-form complex tasks, fighting AI hallucination, validated on academic research. 共识管线：多智能体部门长线任务解决框架，对抗AI幻觉，以学术研究为验证场景。
description.zh: 以多智能体部门协作编排长线复杂任务，降低幻觉，适用于学术研究流程。

description.en: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing with a Web Control Center for responsibility and evidence inspection, plus compaction, scoped semantic memory, safety continuity, and verified delivery; compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向整个 DSH profile 的治理与路由 bundle，提供用于职责与证据检查的 Web Control Center，以及压缩、本地作用域语义记忆、安全连续性与真实验收；兼容 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。

description.en: Offers a plugin marketplace with search, five-dimension scoring, and one-click installation for over 1500 DSH plugins.
description.zh: 提供插件市场，支持搜索、五维评分和 1500+ DSH 插件的一键安装。

description.en: Governs AI agent tasks by aligning goals, planning, orchestrating, and verifying delivery while managing risks.
description.zh: 治理 AI agent 任务，对齐目标与事实，规划调度并验证交付。

description.en: 🧠 The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness. Offline & private, auto-consolidates in its sleep (autoDream), visualized in a memory panel.
description.zh: 会做梦的记忆 — DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记忆插件：跨会话记住你与项目、深夜 autoDream 自动巩固记忆、冲突记忆先冻结待你裁决、全程可回放审计。默认离线：SQLite 配人工可编辑的 Markdown 镜像，提供本地语义检索、实体图谱、交互式记忆库面板及外部 API 与 CLI。

description.en: Local image and MP4 video backgrounds for DSH Web: a sidebar Background panel, saved themes including a built-in window-frame preset, mute toggle, last-background restore, plus /bg, /bg-theme and /bg-clear commands.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 设置本地图片与 MP4 视频背景：侧栏「背景」面板、可保存主题（含内置「画窗」）、声音开关、恢复上次背景，以及 /bg、/bg-theme、/bg-clear 命令。

description.en: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Rust/ratatui Agent TUI，支持流式工具调用、子代理、持久会话和可扩展的 Cordis 客户端界面。

description.en: A temporal context graph, a memory API, retrieval primitives, and a multiple-platform integration mesh — designed to be embedded into any host process.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenContext，提供跨会话持久记忆、提示词自动捕获与召回、会话摘要、结构化洞察和文档检索。

description.en: Unified Harness TUI (ACP client). Self-Improvement TUI plugin of DeepSeek Harness. Everything Here Is Also A Plugin.
自动分类、收录和验证 DeepSeek-Harness 社区插件的市场。 Automatically categorize, curate, and validate the DeepSeek-Harness community plugin marketplace.
description.zh: 自动分类、收录和验证DeepSeek Harness社区插件的市场，提供流畅的发现体验。

description.en: A search tool that provides access to 65,600+ API documents from 20 Chinese open platforms, zero-configuration, supporting Skill and native DSH plugin.
description.zh: 搜索工具，提供20个中国开放平台的6.5万+API文档，零配置，支持Skill和原生DSH插件。

description.en: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.
description.zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.
description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。

description.en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin development.
description.zh: 插件生态基建：浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。

description.en: In-app plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, one-click install, compat badges.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 内置插件商店：浏览、搜索、一键安装、兼容性徽章。

description.en: Orchestrates multiple agents with resource awareness for efficient task execution in Codex and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在Codex和DeepSeek Harness中资源感知地编排多代理，高效执行任务。

description.en: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
description.zh: 多 agent 共享任务板：经 Cordis service key 创建/认领/流转/查询任务。

description.en: DSH plugin ecosystem (700+ plugins)
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的插件生态（700+ 插件）

description.en: Diagnoses current and saved DeepSeek Harness trajectories with AgentDebugX and opens structured reports in its dashboard.
description.zh: 使用 AgentDebugX 诊断当前及已保存的 DeepSeek Harness 轨迹，并在其仪表盘中打开结构化报告。

description.en: A plugin that assists in building and scaffolding other DSH plugins.
description.zh: 辅助构建和脚手架其他 DSH 插件的插件。

description.en: Provides a central hub for managing presets and configurations in the plugin suite.
description.zh: 为插件套件提供预设和配置的集中管理入口。

description.en: IM webhook and local notifications on turn completion, errors, or approval (Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk/Slack/Discord/custom).
description.zh: 回合完成、报错或待审批时发送 IM webhook 与本地通知（飞书/企业微信/钉钉/Slack/Discord/自定义）。

description.en: Serves as a living plugin directory with hourly refresh, daily compatibility tests, an in-app store, and scaffolding tools.
description.zh: 提供实时插件目录，含小时刷新、每日兼容测试、内置商店和脚手架。

description.en: Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.
description.zh: 将只追加的会话日志导出为可读的 Markdown 或 HTML，按轨迹来源分组。

description.en: Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud/self-hosted tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas.
description.zh: 手机浏览器远程控制 dsh web，人在哪都能用（免公网 IP）：官方托管中继 4G 即用，也可自建 relay；一条命令安装电脑端 bridge 与设置页「远程控制」面板（云端/自建切换、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）；隧道数据面端到端加密（E2EE：手机↔电脑端正文与 WS 内容加密，中继只见路由元数据；支持扫码/一次性链接桌面授权，免重复输密码）；HTTP/WebSocket 全量透传，访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额。

description.en: Tunnel-mode remote control for dsh web: the plugin adds an in-harness Settings panel (cloud/self-hosted mode tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback) with same-origin /dsh-remote relay routes; the desktop bridge and self-hosted relay-router in this repo tunnel local dsh web to a phone browser as an installable PWA with access-key auth, live device list and optional traffic quotas.
description.zh: 隧道模式远程控制 dsh web：插件在设置页新增「远程控制」面板（云端/自建模式切换、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）并提供同源 /dsh-remote 路由；仓库自带的电脑端 bridge 与自托管 relay-router 构成隧道，把本地 dsh web 以可安装 PWA 形式开放到手机（访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额）。

description.en: Transforms any text field into a two-way LLM channel, reading user input and filling in requested answers without a chat window.
description.zh: 将任意文本框变成双向大模型通道，读取输入并自动填充回答，无需聊天窗口。

description.en: Blazing fast, Hacker News CLI (TUI)⚡
description.zh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

description.en: ChatGPT OAuth authentication and Codex account management for DeepSeek Harness, including model catalog and usage display.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT OAuth 登录和 Codex 账号管理，包括模型目录和用量展示。

description.en: 自动分类、收录和验证 DeepSeek-Harness 社区插件市场。 Automatically categorize, curate, and validate the DeepSeek-Harness community plugin marketplace.
description.zh: 自动分类、收录和验证 DeepSeek-Harness 社区插件市场。 Automatically categorize, curate, and validate the DeepSeek-Harness community plugin marketplace.

description.en: Rewind a DeepSeek Harness conversation and its workspace together without touching Git; every rewind is a fork and /redo reverses it.
description.zh: 同步回退 DeepSeek Harness 的对话与工作区，不碰 Git；每次回退都是一个 fork，/redo 可撤销。

description.en: Provides integration with the fnOS file system, allowing file operations directly from the assistant.
description.zh: 集成飞牛系统文件操作，便于助手直接存取文件。

description.en: Applies an aurora-themed color scheme with vibrant gradients and cosmic-inspired visual styling.
description.zh: 应用极光主题配色，带鲜艳渐变和星空灵感视觉风格。

description.en: Applies custom visual skins to transform the overall look and feel of the interface with different color schemes and styles.
description.zh: 应用自定义视觉皮肤，通过不同配色和风格改变界面整体外观。

description.en: Displays a comprehensive statistics panel with detailed metrics and performance data for the DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 在界面中展示全面的统计面板，提供详细的指标和性能数据。

description.en: Applies a trading-themed skin with market-oriented colors and financial dashboard aesthetics.
description.zh: 应用交易主题皮肤，采用市场导向配色和金融仪表盘美学。

description.en: Applies a Miku-themed skin featuring vocaloid-inspired colors and anime-styled visual design.
description.zh: 应用初音未来主题皮肤，采用声库角色配色和动漫风格视觉设计。

description.en: Applies a blue fantasy theme with mystical blue tones and imaginative visual elements.
description.zh: 应用蓝色奇幻主题，采用神秘蓝色调和富有想象力的视觉元素。

description.en: Applies a dragon heir theme with epic fantasy styling and dragon-inspired visual motifs.
description.zh: 应用龙裔主题，采用史诗奇幻风格和龙纹视觉元素。

description.en: Provides an AionUI panel component for the client interface, enhancing visual panels.
description.zh: 为客户端界面提供 AionUI 面板组件，增强视觉面板。

description.en: Renders an interactive git commit graph visualization, showing branch topology and history directly within the client interface.
description.zh: 在客户端界面中渲染交互式 Git 提交图谱，直观展示分支拓扑和历史。

description.en: Provides real-time live statistics updates in the user interface, displaying dynamic metrics and activity data as they occur.
description.zh: 在用户界面中实时更新统计信息，动态展示指标和活动数据。

description.en: Adds a virtual desktop pet companion that interacts with users, providing entertainment and playful engagement.
description.zh: 添加虚拟桌面宠物伙伴，与用户互动，带来娱乐和趣味体验。

description.en: Provides SSH connectivity tools, enabling secure remote terminal sessions and server management from within the application.
description.zh: 提供 SSH 连接工具，支持在应用内进行安全远程终端会话和服务器管理。

description.en: Displays a task board interface for visualizing and managing tasks in a kanban-style layout.
description.zh: 以看板式布局展示任务板界面，用于可视化和管理任务。

description.en: Shows a usage dashboard with charts and metrics tracking resource consumption and activity patterns.
description.zh: 展示使用情况仪表盘，用图表和指标跟踪资源消耗和活动模式。

description.en: Aggregates all web UI components into a single bundle for unified deployment and consistent interface enhancement.
description.zh: 将所有 Web UI 组件聚合为单一包，便于统一部署和一致的界面增强。

description.en: Provides a settings panel for configuring web UI preferences, appearance, and interface behavior.
description.zh: 提供设置面板，用于配置 Web UI 偏好、外观和界面行为。

description.en: Applies a Minecraft-themed skin with blocky, pixelated visuals and game-inspired color palette.
description.zh: 应用我的世界主题皮肤，采用方块像素视觉和游戏风格配色。

description.en: Provides a centralized hub for browsing, selecting, and managing available visual skins.
description.zh: 提供集中中心，用于浏览、选择和管理可用视觉皮肤。

description.en: Applies a THS-themed skin with specialized financial data styling and trading-oriented visuals.
description.zh: 应用 THS 主题皮肤，采用专业金融数据风格和交易导向视觉。

description.en: Applies a whale song theme with oceanic tones and serene, flowing visual design elements.
description.zh: 应用鲸歌主题，采用海洋色调和宁静流动的视觉设计元素。

description.en: Applies an XP-themed skin with retro Windows-style visuals and nostalgic interface styling.
description.zh: 应用 XP 主题皮肤，采用复古 Windows 风格视觉和怀旧界面风格。

description.en: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

description.en: Displays a showcase of Semi UI components, demonstrating interface elements for visual customization.
description.zh: 展示 Semi UI 组件示例，用于界面元素的视觉定制。

description.en: Tencent CodeBuddy model provider for DeepSeek Harness with browser OAuth sign-in and Web UI quota display; install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-codebuddy`.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入腾讯 CodeBuddy 模型提供方，支持浏览器 OAuth 登录和 Web UI 用量显示；npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-codebuddy`。

description.en: Save-money plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) — define your own "pause / resume" time windows; at pause time running long tasks are paused (not stopped) automatically, and they resume when the window ends.
description.zh: 自定义时间窗口自动暂停/恢复任务，高峰时段节省 API 费用；含账户余额显示和 10 分钟粒度的消费柱状图。

description.en: TapTap Maker integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP tools, Maker workflow and feature skills, plus a packaged CLI path for project initialization and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 TapTap Maker 集成：提供内置 MCP 工具、Maker 工作流与功能技能，以及用于项目初始化和诊断的随包 CLI 路径。

description.en: Provides a keyboard-first coding agent interface built on the Harness plugin architecture.
description.zh: 基于 Harness 插件架构，提供键盘优先的编码代理界面。

description.en: RDB durable session backend for DeepSeek Harness: implements both session-persistence and session-branch (rewind / retry / fork) providers.
Runs a nine-stage foreign trade acquisition SOP with human approval gates, customer dedup, and audit logging in a safe dry-run mode.
description.zh: 执行九阶段外贸获客SOP，含人工审批、客户去重和审计日志，默认安全演示。

description.en: DSH Web UI little whale-maid theme with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn frames, decorative assets, and a new built-in Codex-style pet.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 小鲸鱼女仆主题：亮暗配色、海洋插画、手绘边框、装饰素材与新增内置codex同款pet。

description.en: Provider abstraction + high-level service for rewind / retry / fork over DeepSeek Harness event-sourced sessions.

Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: Adds a Worktree view to DSH Web UI that groups Sessions by Git worktree while keeping DSH as the source of truth.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加按 Git Worktree 组织 Session 的视角，同时继续由 DSH 管理原始 Project 和 Session 数据。

description.en: Generates 3D code dependency topology graphs across 14 languages with coupling analysis and an integrated AI agent.
description.zh: 生成 14 种语言的 3D 代码依赖拓扑图，具备耦合分析和内置 AI 代理。

description.en: Adds a celebratory fireworks overlay to the DSH Web UI through a happy_fireworks agent tool.
description.zh: 通过 `happy_fireworks` Agent 工具为 DSH Web UI 增加庆祝礼花覆盖层。

description.en: Rewind / retry / fork orchestration (host) plus conversation.chat.node renderer replacement (browser) — message edit / retry actions on user bubbles.
While vibe coding, save an answer you may need later, use Side Chat for a question that suddenly comes up, or open a related conversation for deeper work without losing focus on the current task.
description.zh: Vibe Coding 时，如果突然想到另一个问题，或者看到一段以后还会用到的回答，可以先保存下来、在 Side Chat 里快速问清楚，或另开一个相关会话继续研究，不打断当前任务的开发思路和注意力。

description.en: Configurable deterministic session titles for DeepSeek Harness from semantic prompt fields and templates.
description.zh: 基于语义 prompt 字段与自定义模板的 DeepSeek Harness 确定性会话标题生成插件。

description.en: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a hot-swappable Cordis plugin.
description.zh: 插件树式终端界面：流式 markdown 会话流、工具卡片、模糊命令补全与主题热切换，每个界面组件都是可热替换的 Cordis 插件。

description.en: OMK — Evidence-backed evaluation and observability for prompts, RAG, skills, agents, and workflows. Native Codex, Claude Code, and DeepSeek Harness support.
description.zh: 给提示词、RAG、技能和智能体做有据可查的评测与监控，多评委打分，结果可追溯。

description.en: Visual multi-agent DAG workflows for DeepSeek Harness with live execution, restart recovery, and Feishu integration.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化多智能体 DAG 工作流，支持实时执行、重启恢复和飞书集成。

description.en: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。

description.en: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
description.zh: 任务事件通知中心：6 类事件（提问 / 审批 / 完成 / 子代理完成 / 错误 / 轮次完成），双通道（浏览器通知 + 宿主系统 toast）外加 Bark/Webhook 推送频道（ntfy、Gotify、自建网关）；支持免打扰时段与紧急例外、审批超时二次提醒、完成风暴聚合、通知文本脱敏。

description.en: Provides lightweight market data tools and strategy skills for stock analysis.
description.zh: 提供轻量级行情数据工具和策略技能，辅助股票分析。

description.en: A terminal frontend for DeepSeek Harness built with TypeScript and React/Ink for interactive use.
description.zh: 基于TypeScript和React/Ink的终端前端，用于交互式操作DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Provides a set of tools for diagnosing and jointly debugging ROS 2 systems, helping users identify and resolve issues efficiently.
description.zh: 为 ROS 2 系统提供诊断与联合调试工具，帮助用户高效定位和解决问题。

description.en: Enables efficient diagnosis and joint debugging of ROS 2 applications, streamlining issue resolution workflows.
description.zh: 为 ROS 2 应用提供高效的诊断与联合调试能力，简化问题解决流程。

description.en: Diagnoses ROS 2 issues and supports joint debugging sessions.
description.zh: 用于 ROS 2 问题诊断和联合调试。

description.en: Offers tools to diagnose and debug MoveIt-based robot motion planning setups within ROS 2.
description.zh: 为基于 MoveIt 的机器人运动规划配置提供诊断与调试工具。

description.en: Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist.
description.zh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：HTTP/HTTPS/WS 转发 + TLS（自签名/自定义证书）；HTTP 自适应 Brotli/gzip 与 WebSocket permessage-deflate 双压缩；WS 半开探活，移动端切后台不僵死；启动令牌自动注入，LAN 设备免手工拿 token；DNS 重绑定防护 + 回环-only 上游白名单。

description.en: Browser automation (Playwright) with a live view, an MCP server exposing DSH agents to any MCP client, and GitHub issue/PR/webhook review tools.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化（Playwright，带实时画面）+ MCP Server（把 DSH agent 暴露给任何 MCP 客户端）+ GitHub issue/PR/webhook 评审工具。

description.en: Turns "open with the default application" file requests inside the conversation into the built-in right-Sidebar preview: the browser intercepts `POST /api/present.open` and calls `ctx.sidebarRight.openResource` with the official resource address grammar, so nothing is sent over the network and no renderer ships with the plugin; "show in file manager" is deliberately left untouched.
description.zh: 把对话内「用默认应用打开」的文件请求转成官方右侧栏预览：浏览器端拦截 `POST /api/present.open`，按官方资源地址语法调用 `ctx.sidebarRight.openResource`，不产生网络请求、插件自身不再自带渲染器；「在文件管理器中显示」有意不接管。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI 的实时大纲插件
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI 的实时大纲插件

description.en: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.
description.zh: 多 provider 用量统计框架（v2 适配器契约）：常驻胶囊 + 详情面板；内置 DeepSeek 官方（区间记账法推算每日用量 + 峰谷倒计时徽标，官方无用量接口也能算）与 OpenCode Go；其他数据源只需放入一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入，设置页热插拔，密钥只留在宿主端。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 时装工坊：给 DSH 界面换装——更改主题配色/自定义背景图/自定义视频背景/可调节氛围灯，中英双语 ·DSH Web UI 时装工坊。
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面换装，改主题配色、自定义图片或视频背景，还能调氛围灯，让界面更有个性。

description.en: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生 TUI 前端，通过 Harness 能力提供会话、模型、插件、任务、子代理、待办事项和 Provider 配置，并保留真实的终端滚动历史。

description.en: Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.
description.zh: 提供 DeepSeek Harness 远程控制功能的原生 iOS/Android 应用，支持端到端加密、工作区浏览和会话实时更新等。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Multisim MCP，用于生成电路、运行仿真、诊断与优化设计，并导出实验报告。

description.en: Connects WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Lark, and Telegram to DeepSeek Harness with unified configuration, private-chat and group access controls, and channel-side Agent chat and session commands.
description.zh: 将微信、QQ、钉钉、飞书和 Telegram 接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供统一配置、私聊与群聊访问范围管理，以及渠道内 Agent 对话和会话指令。

description.en: Run a code review bot natively inside DSH

Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 全双工语音对话：按钮或 Ctrl+Shift+V 进入，持续聆听（停顿自动发送）或按住说话，zipformer2 流式识别入可编辑草稿、可选唤醒词；回复按句 Edge TTS 朗读并显示实时字幕，开口即打断播放与回合（真 barge-in）；识别模型本地推理、Edge TTS 在线合成，无需 API Key。

description.en: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的终端编码 Agent，提供全屏备用屏幕 UI、轮次感知的会话导航，以及将一句话需求经过规格、TDD 和验收复跑的分阶段 /ship 流程。

description.en: DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.
description.zh: Minta 记忆引擎的 DSH 原生接入层:合成官方 dsh-mcp-client 行、注册 minta-memory-governance 技能与 session-start 记忆预热,并提供 Minta agent 预设;19 个 MCP 工具由需单独部署的 Minta 引擎(Python/Docker)提供,未部署引擎则无法使用。

description.en: Unofficial Windows and macOS desktop app for DeepSeek Harness, with bundled runtime and automatic reuse of existing DSH environments.
description.zh: Unofficial cross-platform desktop shell with a bundled fallback runtime for DeepSeek Harness Web.

description.en: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。

description.en: FormatForge: forge 30+ file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EML, EPUB, TOML, archives) into AI-readable text via a drag-and-drop inbox, ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result tools and a CLI; scanned PDFs fall back to local OCR or an enhance hint for the session model.
description.zh: FormatForge：把 30+ 种文件格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、EML、EPUB、TOML、压缩包）锻造成 AI 可读文本——网页拖拽入箱自动转换，提供 ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result 工具与 CLI；扫描件回退本地 OCR 或交给会话模型增强。

description.en: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view.
description.zh: dsh 目标生命周期管理与可视化看板：目标、判据、执行、评审都在项目内跟踪，由 graph_* 工具驱动，会话视图内渲染二维泳道看板。

description.en: 本地优先的文献知识库 RAG(DeepSeek Harness 插件):混合检索正文与图注,把模糊记忆定位到具体段落与图表,DOI 一键直达原文。Local-first literature RAG for DSH — turn a fuzzy memory into an e…
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Seven agent-preset modes for DeepSeek Harness, each with a fixed tool boundary, per-mode model routing and fast/deep omd_task delegation tiers, plus a plan-to-execute loop (/mode, /start-work, goal-backed /ulw) and a settings page that remaps models per mode and per tier.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 7 个 Agent 预设模式：每个模式固定工具边界、按模式路由模型，并以 fast/deep 档位委派 omd_task 子代理；含规划到执行闭环（/mode、/start-work、基于 goal 的 /ulw）与逐模式、逐档位重配模型的设置页。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

description.en: Computer use through an external USB HID device: name a target in plain language, a vision model locates it in a cropped window screenshot, and a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 moves the real mouse and types on the real keyboard. 7 tools. Windows has window listing, per-window cropping and automatic window raising; macOS needs pyobjc and has neither; Linux is unsupported.
description.zh: 通过外接 USB HID 硬件做电脑控制：用一句话描述目标，视觉模型在裁剪后的窗口截图里定位，树莓派 Pico 2 驱动真实鼠标和键盘完成动作。7 个工具。Windows 支持窗口枚举、按窗口裁剪与自动抬窗；macOS 需 pyobjc 且不支持这两项；Linux 不支持。

description.en: Skin Center: 151 day/night skin pairs in one package — grid previews, search, one-click try-on, favorites, recently-tried and random skins inside DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 皮肤中心：151 款昼夜成对皮肤一包打尽——网格预览、搜索、一键试穿，支持收藏、最近试穿与随机换肤。

description.en: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
description.zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 eDEX-UI 风格外壳：左侧系统遥测栏（含每核 CPU 迷你趋势图）、右侧 encom-globe 世界地图与上下行流量图、左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: Select text in a committed DSH response to open an independent, persistent, read-only multi-turn Topic bound to source-session evidence and project files while the source Agent keeps running.
description.zh: 选中 DSH 已提交回复中的文字，开启独立、持久、只读的多轮 Topic；Topic 绑定来源会话证据与项目文件，来源 Agent 可继续运行。

description.en: Multi-platform Agent Skills monorepo that mounts as a DeepSeek Harness profile bundle, exposing Chinese writing, Git, plugin-dev, taste, and semantic-linter skills.
description.zh: 多平台 Agent Skills 集合，作为 DeepSeek Harness profile bundle 挂载，提供中文写作、Git、插件开发、Taste 与语义边界检测等 Skill。
